note: Vectors computed directly from the shipped kernel. single-equity-fail-priced exercises the base priced path; multi-fail-partial-credit-private-isin exercises partial-settlement credit, the sha256-salted@1 §25 private-input path, and forward exposure summation; rate-table-version-kill-condition exercises the rate_table_version caller-input defect (execution_state did_not_run). All ISINs/counterparty ids/commitments are synthetic -- no real firm data.

vectors.name: single-equity-fail-priced
vectors.description: One equity SEFP fail, no partial settlement -- straightforward per-fail penalty at the RTS equity rate.

output_payload.note: DECISION-SUPPORT DRAFT -- not a regulatory penalty notice. Deterministic per-ISIN/day cash-penalty recompute against a versioned RTS rate schedule; verify against current CSDR Delegated Reg. (RTS) (EU) 2018/1229 as amended and ESMA RTS (Final Report 13 Oct 2025). Partial-settlement credit applies proportionally. reference_price is caller-supplied per fail -- never derived from notional (fixes art-78-csdr-penalty-calculator's reachability defect; art-78 itself is unchanged).
